paper.canonical: color-mix(in oklab, var(--card) 52%, var(--background)); card 38% on white/latte

paper-deep.canonical: color-mix(in oklab, var(--card) 24%, var(--background)); card 14% on white/latte

note-ink.canonical: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 90%, #c9b8a6); 92% toward #6b4a33 on white/latte

headline.purpose: Stream titles, desk and thread names, empty states, details hero name, group modal title (Switzer).

credits-title.purpose: The record title on a spread's right page (Switzer, balanced).

note-spread.purpose: A member's note on a spread, Literata in note ink; outranks the credits title.

note-solo.purpose: A text-only post, Literata at 62ch, indented to the byline.

note-short.purpose: A short text-only post, Literata, balanced.

note-comment.purpose: Comment bodies and the comment field, Literata in note ink.

message.purpose: Bubble text stays Inter; conversation is not a note.

meta.purpose: Times, dates, counts, running times, track numbers; tabular figures.

shadows.name: fold
shadows.value: linear-gradient(to left, var(--lv-shade), transparent) 22px on the cover edge; linear-gradient(to right, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lv-shade) 50%, transparent), transparent) 18px on the page edge
shadows.purpose: The gutter shade at every spread's fold. --lv-shade is rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32), 0.12 on white/latte.

shadows.name: sleeve
shadows.purpose: Covers in the band; deepens to 0 10px 20px on hover. Small sleeves use 0 4px 10px var(--lv-shade).

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: --lv-lift: post and message composers on :focus-within, with border-color color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 45%, transparent) (0 10px 26px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) on light themes).

shadows.name: play-disc
shadows.purpose: The ink play disc over a spread's cover.

shadows.name: docked-details
shadows.purpose: Details panel as overlay below a 1100px container.

shadows.name: group-modal
shadows.purpose: Group modal card over a rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55) scrim.

shadows.name: lightbox
shadows.purpose: Lightbox image over a rgb(0 0 0 / 0.84) veil.

shadows.name: ink-ring
shadows.purpose: Field focus, composer summon, groove cue flash. Always ink, never spot.

shadows.name: admin-shell
shadows.purpose: Admin Control Room shell; the whole operator surface lifts as one object.

shadows.name: admin-inspector
shadows.purpose: Member inspector only when it overlays the ledger; becomes -28px 0 80px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48) as the phone drawer.

shadows.name: admin-save-state
shadows.purpose: Sticky instance-policy save state above scrolling control ledgers.

motion.name: lv-ease
motion.purpose: Every UI state change (120-380ms), page turns and prints (560-900ms), spot ink settling (700ms).

motion.name: lv-move
motion.purpose: On-screen travel: the tab thumb slide (340ms).

motion.name: lv-spring
motion.purpose: Tactile gestures only: like 520ms, send/Post arm 320ms, play press 320ms, follow and read-check stamp 460ms, group checkbox check 380ms, pin drop 500ms, unread and group picture pop 380ms, listen-along join 560ms.

motion.name: real-time
motion.purpose: The band credit's hairline follows the friend's real position.

motion.name: page-turn
motion.purpose: A new entry's right page swings down onto the fold.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation-duration: 1ms; animation-iteration-count: 1; animation-delay: 0; transition-property: opacity, color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow } + transform: none on sleeves, faces, images
motion.purpose: Scoped to #page-social, .social-group-modal and .social-lightbox: loops stop, entrances settle, nothing travels; color and opacity still ease.

motion.name: ease-admin
motion.purpose: Admin overview reveal, member inspector attachment, bulk-action entry, and dirty save-state movement.

motion.name: admin-state-transitions
motion.value: overview 440ms clip reveal; inspector 280ms translateX(12px); bulk bar 220ms translateY(6px); health pulse 2.8s
motion.purpose: Bounded Admin-only motion; the pulse is its sole loop and communicates live health.

motion.name: admin-reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> 0.01ms duration; 1 iteration; scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: Scoped to #page-admin including pseudo-elements; JavaScript inspector scrolling also switches from smooth to auto.

motion.name: ease-stats-reveal
motion.purpose: Stats B Scene only: stage and cover entrances, chart/rotation/hour reveals, and interaction easing.

motion.name: stats-reveal-durations
motion.value: entry chrome 420ms + 55ms toolbar delay; data composition 800ms; count-up 760ms; number arrival 580ms; covers 640ms + 40ms + 60ms stagger; orbit 620ms + 180ms; curve/area/bloom 600ms + 160ms; metrics from160ms; caption420ms + 220ms; panels460ms + 240ms; navigation count450ms; donut650ms; bars500ms + 12ms stagger; rows450ms; intersection380ms + 24ms stagger capped168ms
motion.purpose: Finite Stats B entrances; graph/ring/hour reveals pause until in view. Quiet updates suppress count-up, scene/chart/row reveals and intersection arrivals.

motion.name: stats-reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> animation: none; transition: none
motion.purpose: Stats descendants and pseudo-elements disable CSS motion; JavaScript skips count-up and pointer tilt, cancels chrome and intersection Web Animations, clears entry state and retains static cover rotations. Social/Admin remain unchanged.

motion.name: stats-artwork-response
motion.value: artwork field opacity 0.2 idle -> 0.43 hover/focus over 600ms; pointer reflection 250ms; in-view ambience 10s alternate; active in-view orbit trace 12s linear
motion.purpose: Stats B only: quiet idle with richer exploration. Actual blurred covers, 70% artwork/foreground color mix, foreground orbit and curve bloom retain the approved stage; document visibility pauses CSS animations.

motion.name: stats-navigation
motion.value: sliding selectors 280ms; cancelable date/content transition 320ms; pointer light and tilt RAF-batched
motion.purpose: Stats selectors remain native pressed-state controls. Navigation retains dim/inert scene, quiet refresh waits for navigation and skips unchanged payloads, and reduced motion skips effects.

breakpoints.name: social-desk-1040
breakpoints.purpose: Feed gains the sticky 300px correspondence desk.

breakpoints.name: social-info-1100
breakpoints.purpose: Details panel docks as an overlay, min(340px, 88%).

breakpoints.name: social-820
breakpoints.purpose: 260px rail; spread cover 34%; smaller credits title and note.

breakpoints.name: social-640
breakpoints.purpose: One Messages pane at a time with a back button; full-width details panel.

breakpoints.name: social-560
breakpoints.purpose: Header stacks; 212px credits; slim composer; 104px spread cover; running times drop.

breakpoints.name: social-touch
breakpoints.purpose: Credit actions, spread play disc and message pin stay in sight.

breakpoints.name: admin-inspector-overlay
breakpoints.purpose: Admin rail narrows, status becomes 2-by-2, policy ledgers stack, and the member inspector overlays the table at min(340px, 88%).

breakpoints.name: admin-local-index
breakpoints.purpose: Admin shell becomes one column; the local rail becomes a sticky horizontal index and table role/joined metadata collapses.

breakpoints.name: admin-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Metrics become 2-by-2, status and forms stack, the ledger becomes identity-first, and the inspector becomes a fixed edge drawer.

breakpoints.name: stats-analysis-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Stats B analysis stacks and rotation/hour rail becomes two columns; donut 100px. Fan retains clamp(250px, 28cqi, 330px), with covers capped at min(230px, 72% of fan height).

breakpoints.name: stats-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Stats B stage and rail stack vertically; fan 245px, donut 120px, panels 16px; controls wrap, secondary times hide. Integrated curve gains a 22px top gap; ResizeObserver selects 400x240 geometry at 560px (210px display height).

patterns.name: Spot ink
patterns.value: coverColor(img) -> getVibrantColorFromImage, cached per URL (96); cachedCoverColor for rebuilt nodes -> --tint -> --spot: var(--tint, var(--lv-house)); --spot-ink: color-mix(in oklab, var(--spot) 58%, var(--foreground))
patterns.purpose: One flat ink per entry, read from its cover (js/social-dom.js); never glow, never state.

patterns.name: Square record, round person
patterns.value: covers 3-4px radius; avatars 50%; a 28px face on the sleeve's corner in the band, sleeve tucked behind the face in rows
patterns.purpose: Records and people never swap shapes.

patterns.name: Notes face
patterns.value: font-family: var(--lv-notes) !important (Literata) on .social-note, #social-post-input, .social-comment-body, .social-comment-input, .social-info-about; placeholders back to var(--font-family) !important
patterns.purpose: styles.css forces font-family with !important on *, so every other face needs !important.

patterns.name: Real waveforms
patterns.value: peaks decoded once, cached in localStorage monochrome-social-peaks:<id>; 8th-percentile floor, 0.12 level floor, exponent 1.4; lightness >= 0.56 on dark grounds, <= 0.4 on light
patterns.purpose: The groove is the track's true waveform, printed in spot ink.

patterns.name: Keyed patching
patterns.value: data-key children with FLIP from getBoundingClientRect (js/social-dom.js)
patterns.purpose: Live re-renders never replay an entrance; only genuinely new nodes animate.

patterns.name: Clip not hide
patterns.value: overflow: clip on spreads, credits, Messages view; band row masks only the side still hiding credits
patterns.purpose: Focus never scrolls a pane sideways.

patterns.name: Literal classes
patterns.value: class names written as literals in JS, never template strings

patterns.name: Admin flat-ledger grammar
patterns.value: status ribbon -> four-cell metric strip -> attached toolbar/table -> permissions/features row ledgers -> instance fields -> sticky save state
patterns.purpose: Preserves the approved option A operator-console order and avoids a generic analytics card mosaic.

patterns.name: Admin semantic chroma
patterns.value: #5ee890 healthy/active/success; #e3b35f degraded/pending; var(--muted-foreground) unknown; var(--destructive) suspended/delete/error
patterns.purpose: Every colored state is paired with plain-language copy; red remains reserved for harmful or failed outcomes.

patterns.name: Admin dialog accessibility
patterns.value: role=dialog + aria-labelledby; aria-modal on phone; inert background; focus close on open; Escape close; focus return to opener
patterns.purpose: The attached inspector becomes a complete modal drawer at the shipped 560px phone condition.

listening-stats.composition: Open 44%/56% giant-minutes/artwork stage with integrated smooth activity curve; covers capped at 230px, caption top margin 18px on desktop/mobile; 58%/42% ranking and rotation/hour rail; full-width history.
listening-stats.colorAuthority: getVibrantColorFromImage on actual fan covers; inherited foreground/theme mixes on unavailable extraction. Local colors reset each render.
listening-stats.chartGeometry: 1000x160 desktop /400x240 compact viewBox;130px/210px display height; responsive rebuild at560px; stems interpolate the same activity curve.
listening-stats.evidenceContext: Local previews use demonstration sessions and real imported cover art. Capture refresh may follow final fixes.
listening-stats.policy: Existing 30-second heard-audio qualification and locks remain authoritative for administrators too; collection continues while reads/export are locked.

navigationMotion.entryReplay: Each tab visit; chrome responds before data; period and quiet updates do not replay.
navigationMotion.quietRefresh: No supersession of navigation; unchanged payloads retain inspected DOM.

listening-stats.rotation: Rounded arc paths; radius62, cap-aware gap, thickness at most10, count-only center, sole positive entry full circle.

components.name: Stats Period Segments
components.description: Stats B native pill period buttons with foreground selected fill, explicit pressed state, visible focus and press feedback. Runtime positions a 280ms sliding indicator; this standalone snippet presents the selected state. Local to Stats.
components.css: .ds-stats-periods { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 70%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-family,Inter,sans-serif); } .ds-stats-periods button { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 32px; min-width: 66px; padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: inherit; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms, background 180ms, opacity 180ms, transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-stats-periods button:hover { color: var(--foreground); background: rgb(var(--highlight-rgb), 0.06); } .ds-stats-periods button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background); box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%); } .ds-stats-periods button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-stats-periods button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.95); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stats-periods button { animation: none; transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Social is the group's shared liner-notes booklet, not a chat timeline or a card feed. A music post is a spread: the cover on the left page, the record's credits and the member's note on the right, a soft shadow at the fold between them. The right page carries the record's running order printed as on the back of a sleeve, or its running groove (the track's real waveform), and both play from the exact track or moment clicked. Above the feed, a single-row listening band lists who is playing what as credits: a round face on the corner of a square sleeve, a name, a track, a live hairline following their real position. At wide containers a correspondence desk beside the feed lists recent conversations, and Messages keeps the messenger fundamentals (rail, thread, docked composer, details panel) with every row wearing the sleeve of its last shared record.

The material is paper and ink. Paper plies come from the theme tokens; text is foreground ink; members' own words are set in a book face (Literata) in a faintly warm note ink. Each entry is printed in one spot ink: the cover's own color, read once and laid flat into tints, borders, running numbers and the groove, never as glow. Where there is no art, a muted mauve house ink stands in. Two fixed signal hues remain, each with one meaning: presence green for someone here now, like-red for a liked post.

Motion is the booklet being handled: one strong ease-out for UI, a smooth ease-in-out for things travelling across the screen, a drawer curve for the details panel, and a slight overshoot only on tactile gestures. A new entry's right page swings down onto the fold; pointing at a cover lifts the left page from it.
keyCharacteristics: Posts as spreads: square cover left (37% of the spread), credits and note right, a gutter shadow at the fold
One flat spot ink per entry from its cover (`--tint`), the house ink without art; no glow
Records are square (3-4px corners), people are round; a face sits on its sleeve's corner
Literata for members' notes only; Switzer for titles and credits; Inter for the interface
Hairline rules at 10% / 20% ink, tabular running times, no uppercase labels
Listening band of credits in one scrolling row; correspondence desk at 300px from a 1040px container
Container queries on `#page-social`, never viewport media queries, for layout
Spring only on tactile gestures; reduced motion keeps color and opacity, drops travel

rules.name: The Flat Spot Ink Rule
rules.body: Each entry is printed in exactly one spot ink, its cover's color through `--tint`, or the house ink. It is laid flat as tint, border, numeral or waveform; it never glows, blurs, or casts light.

rules.name: The Cover-Never-Marks-State Rule
rules.body: A spot ink says which record, never whether someone is live, unread, selected or followed. State is ink, wash, weight, or presence green.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Presence green means a human is here now; like-red means liked. Neither appears anywhere else, and no other fixed hue may carry a state.

rules.name: The Notes Face Rule
rules.body: Literata sets only what a member wrote for the booklet: feed notes, the post composer's text, comments and the comment field, a member's "about" line. Placeholders, messages, names and controls stay Inter.

rules.name: The Credits Rule
rules.body: Switzer appears only on titles and headings; it never sets body, names or controls.

rules.name: The Tabular Readout Rule
rules.body: Every time, position, count and track number uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Container Knows Rule
rules.body: Layout responds to `@container social`, never a viewport media query.

rules.name: The Clip-Not-Hide Rule
rules.body: Spreads, credits and the Messages view use `overflow: clip`, never `hidden`, so focusing a field can never scroll a pane sideways.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Panels never cast shadow at rest; only sleeves (objects) and the fold (a crease) do. Lift is a response to focus.

dos: **Do** express every neutral through theme tokens via the `--lv-*` mixes; `#5ee890`, `#ff5470` (`#c8173c` on light themes) and the house ink's `#a08f99` are the only fixed hues.
**Do** print each entry in one spot ink from `--tint`, falling back to the house ink, laid flat.
**Do** draw records square and people round, and put a member's face on their sleeve's corner.
**Do** set members' own words in Literata with note ink, titles and credits in Switzer, everything else in Inter, each with `font-family: … !important`.
**Do** draw grooves from real decoded peaks, cached once per track.
**Do** use `@container social` for every layout change, and `overflow: clip` on spreads and panes.
**Do** keep the spring for tactile gestures and the ease-out curve for everything else, and make sure new motion degrades under the reduced-motion block.
**Do** write class names as literals in JS so PurgeCSS keeps them.
**Do** use `tabular-nums` on every time, position, count and track number.
donts: **Don't** let a spot ink glow, blur or cast light, or mark state (live, unread, selected, followed).
**Don't** use presence green for anything but presence, or like-red for anything but likes.
**Don't** shadow a resting panel; only sleeves and the fold carry shade.
**Don't** round a cover into a disc or square off a person.
**Don't** set messages, names, placeholders or controls in Literata.
**Don't** add uppercase labels or kickers; hierarchy is size, weight and face.
**Don't** fake waveforms or tracklists with placeholder bars or rows.
**Don't** show credit actions, the spread play disc or the message pin at rest on pointer devices; they appear on hover or focus.
